title: Product Review - FeiyuTech SCORP Pro/SCORP C/SCORP Brushless Focus/Zoom Motor
description:
Join the Otherworldly Oddities as we review the FeiyuTech SCORP Pro, SCORP-C, and SCORP Focus/Zoom Brushless Motor. It will take the troublesome process of focusing/zooming out of your hands (being that you are using a pressure sensitive gimbal, and right into the SCORP platform. I left out a bunch of features because I wanted to show you the raw functionality of this piece of equipment, but we seriously hope you enjoy this video and as always LIKE, SHARE and SUBSCRIBE for more content.

FeiyuTech is a world leader in manufacturing videography stabilization technology that combines imagination and innovation.
